所以这仍然是一项正在进行的工作，但我有一个想法，并且我付诸实践。请原谅它的形状和颜色，因为我知道这会让它更难理解，这本来就是个人的（形状像极客幽灵，哈哈），但像往常一样，如果我不发布它，我会暂时忘记它，并可能会失去它，哈哈。

所以，首先是层叠背景框。它允许您使用级联来生成独立于主题的背景，接下来是主题。我有左、中、右。每个都有一个删除背景节点，该节点通向使用生成的背景作为背景的图层节点。比例改变主体的大小，x 左右移动（50 是中性基础），y 上下移动（50 是中性基础），基本上它可以让您生成 4 个图像并将它们分层以创建单个 3 主体图像。

复杂且正在进行中。

有 IP 适配器、Controlnets、Loras、Cascade、SVD、LCM 使用、测试和同时使用一堆东西。借用了级联和 SVD 组并根据我的目的对其进行了修改。

任何关于如何改进这一点的建议都是受欢迎的，因为事实证明这非常有趣，我已经在除了 animate diff 之外的所有内容中进行了工作，并且希望在 SVD 之后也能进行工作，哈哈。

o.en:
So this one is still a work in progress, but I had an idea, and I ran with it. Forgive the shape and colors as I know it makes it harder to follow, this is meant to be a personal one (Shaped like Geeky Ghost lol), but like always if I don't post it I'll forget about it for awhile and likely lose it lol.

So, first up is the cascade background box. It lets you use cascade to generate a background independently from the subjects, next are the subjects. I have left, center, and right. Each has a remove background node that leads into a layer node that uses the generated background as a background. The scale changes the size of the subject, x moves it left and right (50 is neutral base), y moves it up and down (50 is neutral base), basically it lets you generate 4 images and layer them to create a single 3 subject image.

Complicated and a work in progress.

Has IP adapter, Controlnets, Loras, Cascade, SVD, LCM usage, testing and playing with a bunch of stuff at once. Borrowed the cascade and SVD groups and modified them for my purposes.

Any advice on how to improve this is welcomed as this turned out to be pretty fun and I've worked everything in but animate diff and would like to work that in as well after SVD lol.
